subject.title: fix(kill-tree): verify process group leader before using group kill to prevent gateway SIGTERM (#76259)

question: Should OpenClaw accept leader-verified group kill with direct-PID fallback as the default for omitted `detached` Unix cleanup, while requiring known detached callers to pass `detached: true` explicitly?
rationale: This fixes a real gateway-termination bug but changes shared process cleanup semantics for every caller that omits `detached`, so CI alone cannot settle the compatibility and descendant-cleanup tradeoff.

options.title: Accept After Refresh
options.body: Rebase the branch, resolve CI/conflicts, and land this approach if maintainers accept safer gateway behavior over implicit descendant cleanup for unverifiable omitted callers.

options.title: Require Full Caller State
options.body: Ask for more call sites to carry explicit spawn detachment before merge, reducing fallback reliance but expanding the audit surface.

options.title: Replace With Narrower Fix
options.body: Close or supersede this PR only if maintainers prefer a different process-tree contract or a maintainer-owned replacement branch.

recommendation.title: Accept After Refresh
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, resolve CI/conflicts, and land this approach if maintainers accept safer gateway behavior over implicit descendant cleanup for unverifiable omitted callers.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed and merged the prior default-preserving process-tree fix, so they are the clearest history-backed owner for the compatibility tradeoff.
